parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is a rotation blade of the knife made of stainless steel, forming the sharp cutting edge.
parts.Functional_description: It performs the cutting function by rotating or folding out from the handle to slice or cut materials.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or pivot around a hinge point to open or close relative to the handle.

parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is another rotation blade of the knife, also made of stainless steel, designed for cutting or slicing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as an additional or alternative cutting edge, possibly for different cutting tasks or angles.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or fold in and out of the handle, similar to the first blade, allowing safe storage and use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the knife, made of aluminum alloy, providing structure and grip.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the rotation mechanism for the blades and provides a comfortable and secure grip for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the blades rotate or fold into it, serving as the main support structure.
